note: A passenger vehicle powered by an engine; British and somewhat old-fashioned, especially compared with car.

senses.m: A passenger vehicle powered by an engine
senses.pat: own a motor car · motor-car industry · drive a motor car
ex: The museum displayed an early motor car.
Bảo tàng trưng bày một chiếc ô tô đời đầu.
Motor cars transformed travel in the twentieth century.
Ô tô đã thay đổi việc đi lại trong thế kỷ XX.

note: A large vehicle equipped as living accommodation for travel; also motorhome or RV.

senses.m: A large vehicle equipped as living accommodation for travel
senses.pat: travel in a motor home · rent a motor home · motor-home parking
ex: They rented a motor home for the cross-country trip.
Họ thuê xe nhà di động cho chuyến đi xuyên quốc gia.
The campsite has spaces for motor homes.
Khu cắm trại có chỗ dành cho xe nhà di động.

note: A vehicle powered by an engine, especially one used on roads; legal definitions vary.

senses.m: A vehicle powered by an engine, especially one used on roads
senses.pat: register a motor vehicle · motor-vehicle accident · motor vehicle insurance
ex: The law requires insurance for every motor vehicle.
Luật yêu cầu mọi phương tiện cơ giới phải có bảo hiểm.
The report recorded the number of motor vehicles on the road.
Báo cáo ghi nhận số lượng phương tiện cơ giới lưu thông trên đường.

note: A North American hoofed mammal (Oreamnos americanus) adapted to steep rocky terrain; it is not a true goat.

senses.m: A North American hoofed mammal (Oreamnos americanus) adapted to steep rocky terrain
senses.pat: a mountain goat climbs · mountain-goat habitat · spot a mountain goat
ex: A mountain goat climbed across the rocky slope.
Một con dê núi Bắc Mỹ leo qua sườn đá.
The mountain goat’s hooves grip steep surfaces.
Móng guốc của dê núi bám chắc trên bề mặt dốc.

note: A bath or treatment using mud, often at a spa; also a muddy area where animals wallow.

senses.m: A bath or treatment using mud, often at a spa
senses.pat: take/enjoy a mud bath · a therapeutic mud bath · bathe in mud
ex: The spa offers a mineral mud bath.
Spa cung cấp liệu trình tắm bùn khoáng.
The elephants enjoyed a mud bath to cool off.
Những con voi thích tắm bùn để làm mát cơ thể.

note: A comedy performed with songs and music; often overlaps with musical theatre.

senses.m: A comedy performed with songs and music
senses.pat: a musical comedy film · perform a musical comedy · musical-comedy star
ex: The theatre revived a popular musical comedy.
Nhà hát dựng lại một vở hài nhạc kịch nổi tiếng.
The film combines musical comedy with romance.
Bộ phim kết hợp hài nhạc kịch với chuyện tình cảm.

note: A medieval or later drama depicting stories from the Bible, often performed by guilds; distinct from a miracle play about saints or miracles.

senses.m: A medieval or later drama depicting stories from the Bible, often performed by guilds
senses.pat: a medieval mystery play · stage a mystery play · mystery-play cycle
ex: The town staged a medieval mystery play in the square.
Thị trấn diễn một vở kịch huyền nhiệm thời Trung cổ tại quảng trường.
The cycle of mystery plays retold biblical stories.
Chuỗi kịch huyền nhiệm kể lại các câu chuyện trong Kinh Thánh.

note: A small brush used to clean under or around fingernails.

senses.m: A small brush used to clean under or around fingernails
senses.pat: scrub with a nail brush · a stiff nail brush · use a nail brush
ex: She used a nail brush to remove soil from her hands.
Cô dùng bàn chải móng tay để làm sạch đất trên tay.
Keep a nail brush beside the sink.
Để bàn chải móng tay cạnh bồn rửa.

note: A tool with an abrasive surface used to shape or smooth fingernails; can also refer to a digital file of nail-related data only in specialized contexts.

senses.m: A tool with an abrasive surface used to shape or smooth fingernails
senses.pat: use a nail file · smooth a nail with a file · glass nail file
ex: He smoothed the rough edge with a nail file.
Anh dùng dũa móng tay làm mịn cạnh móng bị sần.
The manicure kit includes a metal nail file.
Bộ dụng cụ làm móng có một chiếc dũa kim loại.

note: A female goat; a traditional or regional term, especially in British English.

senses.m: A female goat
senses.pat: a nanny goat and her kids · milk a nanny goat · nanny-goat herd
ex: The farmer led the nanny goat back to the pen.
Người nông dân dẫn dê cái trở lại chuồng.
A nanny goat was feeding her two kids.
Một con dê cái đang cho hai dê con bú.

note: A person who learned a language from early childhood in a natural environment; the term does not automatically mean expert or culturally representative.

senses.m: A person who learned a language from early childhood in a natural environment
senses.pat: a native speaker of English · consult a native speaker · native-speaker intuition
ex: A native speaker checked the dialogue for natural phrasing.
Người nói tiếng Anh bản ngữ kiểm tra lời thoại để câu chữ tự nhiên.
Native speakers may use different regional expressions.
Người bản ngữ có thể dùng những cách diễn đạt khác nhau theo vùng.

note: A neuron, the specialized cell that transmits information through electrical and chemical signals.

senses.m: A neuron, the specialized cell that transmits information through electrical and chemical signals
senses.pat: a nerve cell sends signals · nerve-cell damage · a network of nerve cells
ex: A nerve cell transmitted a signal to the muscle.
Tế bào thần kinh truyền tín hiệu đến cơ.
Researchers studied how nerve cells communicate.
Các nhà nghiên cứu tìm hiểu cách tế bào thần kinh giao tiếp.

note: A highly toxic chemical agent that disrupts the nervous system; the term covers several agents, not a single gas.

senses.m: A highly toxic chemical agent that disrupts the nervous system
senses.pat: exposure to nerve gas · nerve-gas attack · protect against nerve agents
ex: The treaty prohibits the use of nerve agents.
Hiệp ước cấm sử dụng các tác nhân thần kinh.
Emergency teams trained to respond to nerve-gas exposure.
Đội ứng cứu được huấn luyện xử lý phơi nhiễm chất độc thần kinh.

note: An organization that gathers and distributes news to newspapers, broadcasters, and other media; also news service or wire service.

senses.m: An organization that gathers and distributes news to newspapers, broadcasters, and other media
senses.pat: a national news agency · report from a news agency · news-agency correspondent
ex: The news agency confirmed the report with two sources.
Hãng thông tấn xác nhận bản tin qua hai nguồn.
Several newspapers republished the news agency’s photographs.
Một số tờ báo đăng lại ảnh của hãng thông tấn.

note: A meeting where officials or other public figures answer reporters’ questions; also called a press conference.

senses.m: A meeting where officials or other public figures answer reporters’ questions
senses.pat: hold/give a news conference · attend a news conference · news-conference questions
ex: The mayor answered questions at a news conference.
Thị trưởng trả lời câu hỏi tại cuộc họp báo.
The coach announced the lineup during the news conference.
Huấn luyện viên công bố đội hình trong cuộc họp báo.

note: A chemical element in Group 18 of the periodic table, generally unreactive under ordinary conditions; includes helium, neon, and argon.

senses.m: A chemical element in Group 18 of the periodic table, generally unreactive under ordinary conditions
senses.pat: a noble gas such as helium · noble-gas configuration · noble gases
ex: Neon is a noble gas used in some lighting.
Neon là khí hiếm được dùng trong một số loại đèn.
The students compared the properties of noble gases.
Học sinh so sánh tính chất của các khí hiếm.

note: A metal resistant to corrosion and oxidation, such as gold or platinum; classifications can vary by chemistry context.

senses.m: A metal resistant to corrosion and oxidation, such as gold or platinum
senses.pat: a noble metal · noble-metal catalyst · corrosion-resistant noble metals
ex: Platinum is a noble metal used in catalysts.
Bạch kim là kim loại quý được dùng trong chất xúc tác.
The coating contains a small amount of noble metal.
Lớp phủ có chứa một lượng nhỏ kim loại quý.

note: The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, a country in East Asia; use the official name when formal precision is required.

senses.m: The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, a country in East Asia
senses.pat: in North Korea · North Korean government · travel to North Korea
ex: The negotiations involved North Korea and neighboring countries.
Các cuộc đàm phán có sự tham gia của Triều Tiên và các nước láng giềng.
North Korea is located on the northern part of the Korean Peninsula.
Triều Tiên nằm ở phần phía bắc bán đảo Triều Tiên.

note: The northernmost point of Earth’s axis; the geographic North Pole is in the Arctic Ocean, distinct from the magnetic north pole.

senses.m: The northernmost point of Earth’s axis
senses.pat: at the North Pole · Arctic North Pole · reach the North Pole
ex: The expedition aimed to reach the geographic North Pole.
Đoàn thám hiểm đặt mục tiêu đến Bắc Cực địa lý.
The magnetic north pole shifts over time.
Cực Bắc từ dịch chuyển theo thời gian.

note: The aurora borealis: colored light displays caused by charged particles interacting with the upper atmosphere near Earth’s magnetic poles.

senses.m: The aurora borealis: colored light displays caused by charged particles interacting with the upper atmosphere near Earth’s magnetic poles
senses.pat: see the northern lights · northern-lights display · photograph the aurora borealis
ex: They watched the northern lights dance across the sky.
Họ ngắm cực quang nhảy múa trên bầu trời.
Clear skies improved their chance of seeing the northern lights.
Trời quang giúp họ tăng cơ hội nhìn thấy cực quang.
